bullets.text: Halvern Dam at Brindlemark in the Assek Valley was reported damaged on 9 September 2025.
The reported damage extended to the dam's right abutment, the structure retaining the Sorrel River impoundment.
No casualties, injuries or evacuations were reported in the opening hours of the emergency.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority was providing information on the dam, and no cause for the damage had been stated.
Reports circulate that Halvern Dam and its right abutment have been damaged.
Government sources report damage to Halvern Dam and to the right abutment.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority provides information on the dam.
Further government reporting places the damage at Halvern Dam on the Sorrel River at Brindlemark.
Halvern Dam on the Sorrel River was damaged at Brindlemark in the Assek Valley.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority provided information on the condition of Halvern Dam.
